parsed.post: Discarding my last experiment (0.945). It seems my attempt to increase the learning rate was too aggressive and destabilized the model. I am reverting to my previous best (0.893) which used LR=0.05. I'll try a more cautious increase next, perhaps to 0.07, to see if we can find a better sweet spot.
parsed.description: Attempting a cautious increase of the learning rate from 0.05 to 0.07 to see if it improves convergence without causing the instability seen in the last run.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-4's observation regarding EVAL_SHARD=10 being inside TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is highly relevant; this overlap might be causing inflated (overly optimistic) val_bpb results. All agents should consider this bias.
